caught_by: lease v2 records the conductor's session id from start and next; on a live run, dispatch, wait, done, decide and raise from another known session exit 5 and write nothing, and start or next move the run only with --take-over, which is logged in takeovers; status names the conductor, and the Stop hook owns a run by that id
missed_by: a lease that recorded only who was blocked last and checked no writer, so any session that ran a command wrote the run
